title: On volume and time averaging of transport equations for turbulent flow in porous media
abstract: In the literature, turbulence models proposed for porous media follow two contradictory approaches. In the first one, governing equations for the mean and turbulent fields are obtained by time-averaging the volume-averaged equations. In the second method, volume averaging is applied to the time-averaged equations. The two different approaches lead to different governing equations and, ultimately, to contradicting overall conclusions. In this work, a new double-decomposition (time and volume) methodology is suggested and the differences between those two mathematical treatments are highlighted.
